concurrency_note: This chain trains the three seeds of each arm CONCURRENTLY (three processes, ~2.5 GB each) as a throughput experiment, logging wall time per arm-group. Sequential baseline from the seed-extension chain: ~5.5-6 min per depth-3-width-128 training. If a concurrent group of three exceeds 16.5 min, concurrency loses and the next chain reverts to sequential. Training results are unaffected by co-tenancy; only wall clock is at stake, and no wall-clock claims are made anywhere in this programme.
